1.text: Ntukagirire abantu babi ishyari,Kandi ntukifuze kubana na bo,

2.text: Kuko imitima yabo itekereza kurenganya,Kandi ururimi rwabo ruvuga ibyo kugira nabi.

3.text: Ubwenge ni bwo bwubaka urugo,Kandi rukomezwa no kujijuka.

4.text: Kumenya ni ko kuzuza amazu yo muri rwo,Mo ibintu byose by'igiciro cyinshi n'iby'igikundiro.

6.text: Uzajye gusembura intambara ufite inama z'ubwenge,Aho abajyanama benshi bari haba amahoro.

7.text: Ubwenge burenga umupfapfa ntabushyikire,Iyo ari mu iteraniro ntabumbura umunwa.

9.text: Imigambi y'ubupfapfa ni yo cyaha,Kandi umukobanyi ni umuziro mu bantu.

10.text: Nugamburura mu makuba,Gukomera kwawe kuba kubaye ubusa.

11.text: Abajyanirwa gupfa ubarokore,Kandi abarindiriye kwicwa ntubazibukire.

12.text: Nuvuga uti “Dore ntabwo twabimenye”,Ntuzi ko Igera imitima ari yo ibizi?Irinda ubugingo bwawe ni yo ibimenya,Mbese ntizagororera umuntu wese ibihwanye n'imirimo yakoze?

13.text: Mwana wanjye, jya urya ubuki kuko buryoha,Kandi ingabo zabwo ziryohera akanwa kawe.

14.text: Ni ko kumenya ubwenge bizamerera ubugingo bwawe,Nububona ni bwo n'ingororano zizaboneka,Kandi ibyiringiro byawe ntibizaba iby'ubusa.

15.text: Wa munyabyaha we, ntugace igico ku rugo rw'umukiranutsi,Ntugasahure ubuturo bwe,

16.text: Kuko umukiranutsi naho yagwa karindwi yakongera akabyuka,Ariko abanyabyaha bazagushwa n'amakuba.

17.text: Ntukishime umwanzi wawe aguye,Kandi ntukagire umutima unezezwa n'uko atsembwe,

18.text: Kugira ngo Uwiteka atabireba akababazwa na byo,Akirengagiza uburakari yamurakariye.

20.text: Kuko nta ngororano y'umuntu mubi,Urumuri rw'ukiranirwa ruzazima.

21.text: Mwana wanjye, wubahe Uwiteka n'umwami,Kandi ntukishyire mu by'abajya irya n'ino,

22.text: Kuko amakuba yabo azabatungura.Ni nde wamenya kurimbuka kwabo bose?

23.text: Ibi na byo ni imigani y'abanyabwenge:Kuba intinyamaso mu rubanza si byiza,

24.text: Ukiza umunyabyaha ati “Ufite urubanza”,Azavumwa n'igihugu kandi amahanga azamwanga urunuka.

25.text: Ariko abamucyaha bazagubwa neza,Kandi umugisha mwiza uzabazaho.

27.text: Banza witegure ibyo ku gasozi,Uringanize imirima yawe,Hanyuma uzabone kūbaka inzu.

28.text: Ntugashinje umuturanyi wawe nta mpamvu,Kandi ntugashukanishe ururimi rwawe.

29.text: Ntukavuge uti “Ibyo yankoreye nzabimwitura,Mwiture ibihwanye n'imirimo yakoze.”

30.text: Nanyuze ku murima w'umunyabute,No ku ruzabibu rw'umuntu ubuze ubwenge.

31.text: Nasanze hose ari amahwa,Hose ifurwe yarahazimagije,Kandi uruzitiro rwaho rw'amabuye rwarasenyutse.

32.text: Nuko ndebye mbyitegereza neza,Mbibonye mbikuramo gusobanukirwa.

33.text: Uti “Henga nsinzire gato,Nihweture kanzinya,Kandi nipfunyapfunye nsinzire.”

34.text: Uko ni ko ubukene buzagufata nk'umwambuzi,N'ubutindi bukagutera nk'ingabo.
